contracts.source: https://docs.uniswap.org/contracts/v3/reference/deployments/base-deployments (Uniswap, SwapRouter02 row, Base Sepolia column; checked 2026-10-09)

notes: Every address was also checked on chain on 2026-10-09 against https://sepolia.base.org: eth_chainId is 0x14a34, each address has code, USDC.decimals() is 6, WETH.decimals() is 18, and SwapRouter02.WETH9() returns the WETH address above.

Not listed on purpose: Uniswap's UniversalRouter (0x492E6456D9528771018DeB9E87ef7750EF184104 on the same page) and Permit2 (0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3). With them, the token approval goes to Permit2, and the router is authorized through a Permit2 allowance (a Permit2 event M2 doesn't decode yet) or an off-chain signature (invisible until M7). SwapRouter02 takes a plain ERC-20 approval, which M2's effects show directly.
